verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI is a speech-AI API platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer versioned pipelines or configurations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented way to version, review, or roll back user automations. The agent-instructions refetch of the 'latest integration prompt' only keeps a coding agent's docs current, which is an adjacent feature and not versioning of the user's own automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
